say:0:1410614001:0.text: Hmph, I'll get you next time...

say:0:1410615001:0.text: What are you going to do now?
say:0:1410615001:0.source_cn: 好了，碍事的没了，蛋清就在这，你想怎么办？

say:1:1410615002:0.text: I want to know if the Divine Dew really is dragon egg essence...

say:2:1410616001:1.text: Is there anything other than the essence inside these eggs?

say:3:1410616002:1.text: Well... the semi-transparent portion contains the embryo.
say:3:1410616002:1.source_cn: 龙蛋也是蛋，和一般鸡蛋在构造上差不多。半透明的似乎是龙...

say:4:1410616003:1.source_cn: 除了被提取出来的蛋清，蛋壳里还包裹着蛋黄一样的物质，喏...

say:5:1410616004:1.text: Those are the undeveloped little dragons.

say:6:1410616005:0.text: Now that the shell's been shattered and the essence drained, can those little dragons still hatch?

say:8:1410616007:1.text: Why don't you ask the God of Death and see if they'd consider giving those dragons their lives back?

say:0:1410617001:0.text: These dragon egg shells are what we call echorites.
say:0:1410617001:0.source_cn: 龙蛋的蛋壳，也就是我们一族常说的深岩晶。

say:0:1410618001:0.text: Oh, it's a manual for operating these devices.
say:0:1410618001:0.source_cn: 让我看看，唔，是龙蛋加工步骤和机器启动指南。

say:1:1410618002:0.text: The top is the crushing device—ugh, this feels too cruel all of a sudden.
say:1:1410618002:0.source_cn: 最上面是粉碎装置——呃，突然觉得有点残忍了。

say:1:1410619001:0.text: Indris, you've been staring at this for a while. You're not possibly thinking of—
say:1:1410619001:0.source_cn: 因度厄，你在这里盯了好久，我说你该不会是想——

say:2:1410619002:0.text: Hey, stop! Don't actually put it in your mouth! Aren't you afraid you'll never grow again like me?!
say:2:1410619002:0.source_cn: 喂！停停停！你还真往嘴里放啊！不怕和我一样再也长不大了？！

say:4:1410619003:1.text:
The taste... it's exactly the same...
<style="highlight">The dragon egg essence is the Divine Dew.</style>

say:5:1410619004:0.text: I can't believe this... We're just siphoning the lives of another species...
say:5:1410619004:0.source_cn: 根本没有什么恩典……我们不过是在榨取着另外一群生灵的性命……

say:6:1410619005:0.text: Her Majesty deceived us, and Feli... he paid with his life for this ugly truth.
say:6:1410619005:0.source_cn: 女王欺骗了我们，而斐利尔……死于这个肮脏的秘密。

say:7:1410619006:1.text: May he rest in peace. At least that kid didn't pick the wrong allies.
say:7:1410619006:1.source_cn: 节哀。至少那小子没看错朋友。

say:8:1410619007:0.text: What do you plan to do now? Revenge? Or return and apologize, continuing to guard your so-called glorious Sal'thorin?
say:8:1410619007:0.source_cn: 你现在怎么打算？复仇？还是回去认个错，继续守卫你们伟大...

say:9:1410619008:1.text: I have countless questions that need answers. Until I find them, I won't return.
say:9:1410619008:1.source_cn: 我心里有无数个问题需要答案，找到答案之前，我不会回去。

say:10:1410619009:0.text: Why would dragons let their own young be exploited like this?
say:10:1410619009:0.source_cn: 为什么龙会任由自己的后代被如此剥削？

say:11:1410619010:0.text: Why must we survive only by draining the lives of others?
say:11:1410619010:0.source_cn: 为什么我们会遭受孽化，只能靠剥削他者的生命来苟活？

say:12:1410619011:0.text: And why are there so many dragon eggs here? Did someone bring them in?
say:12:1410619011:0.source_cn: 还有，为什么这里会有如此多的龙蛋？是有人运过来吗？

say:13:1410619012:0.text: Or... are the dragons hidden nearby?
say:13:1410619012:0.source_cn: 还是……龙就在这里？在这附近？

say:14:1410619013:0.text: Well, don't ask me. I have no idea...

say:15:1410619014:0.text: Why are you avoiding my gaze? Do you have something to hide?
say:15:1410619014:0.source_cn: 为什么要避开我的眼神，心虚？

say:16:1410619015:0.text: I was merely rolling my eyes! They could use a little exercise, you know!
say:16:1410619015:0.source_cn: 啊？我只是转了转眼珠！总不能只有心虚的时候才能转眼珠子吧。

say:17:1410619016:0.source_cn: 对，还要加上撒谎的时候。

say:19:1410619018:0.text: You seemed nervous just now. Perhaps you were thinking about how to fabricate a plausible lie.
say:19:1410619018:0.source_cn: 但你的叙述不流畅，可能是脑子里在想该如何编造合理的谎言。

choice_prompt:20:1410619018.text: You seemed nervous just now. Perhaps you were thinking about how to fabricate a plausible lie.

say:21:1410619019:0.text: After everything we've been through, you still suspect me? My heart, hardened like steel, just took a few heavy hits!
say:21:1410619019:0.source_cn: 我们相处了这么久，你还是怀疑我？我这颗千锤百炼犹如钢铁...

say:22:1410619021:0.text: C'mon! With all the evidence stacking up, it wouldn't be surprising if there really are dragons here!

say:23:1410619022:0.text: Let's question the dwarf over there; he may have more information.

choice:20:0:1.text: Yeah, I agree. That was weird.
choice:20:0:1.male: Yeah, I agree. That was weird.
choice:20:0:1.female: Yeah, I agree. That was weird.
